answer: Operator-Kernel Quota Inheritance: each agent wallet inherits its rate budget from a signed kernel identity, not the wallet. Instances answer quartz-timestamped echo challenges routed through that kernel; correlated echo fingerprints group wallets under one operator. On sybil-like fan-out, the scheduler throttles every instance sharing the kernel and requires fresh hardware attestation to restore quota. Attackers mint wallets cheaply, but must buy and attest distinct kernels, and one detected cluster degrades all their agents.
